item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China today. Meanwhile, the cloud band associated with a broad area of low pressure over the southern part of the South China Sea will cover the coastal areas of Guangdong. With the band of cloud thinning out gradually over the weekend, daytime temperatures will rise slightly over the region. A dry replenishment of the monsoon will affect the coast of southern China gradually on Sunday. It will be mainly fine and windy over the region in the following couple of days. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong persistently in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cool in the morning and at night over the region.
